evidence: Job created with title 'QA Test Engineer', industry 'Technology', employment type 'Full-time', location 'San Francisco, CA', salary '$80k - $120k', description, and skills 'Testing', 'Selenium', 'Automation'. Job appears in employer dashboard and job-seeker listing with correct details and posting date 'Yesterday'.

Job seekers can browse the complete list of 9 available jobs with accurate result count displayed as 'Showing 9 jobs'. Can successfully navigate to individual job listing (QA Test Engineer) by clicking on it.

Job card displays all required information: title 'QA Test Engineer', company 'TechCorp Solutions', industry 'Technology', employment type 'Full-time', location 'San Francisco, CA', salary range '$80k - $120k', posting date 'Yesterday', and required skills 'Testing', 'Selenium', 'Automation'.

Job details page displays all matching information: title 'QA Test Engineer', company 'TechCorp Solutions', industry 'Technology', employment type 'Full-time', location 'San Francisco, CA', salary '$80k - $120k', posted date 'Posted Yesterday', and required skills 'Testing', 'Selenium', 'Automation'.
Job seeker successfully submitted application with name 'John Doe', email 'john.doe@example.com', and message. Form was cleared after submission, indicating successful submission.

Application form rejected submission when email field contained invalid syntax 'invalid-email'; only accepted and submitted form when email was valid 'john.doe@example.com'. Name and message were required; phone was optional.
Employer dashboard displays QA Test Engineer job with application list. Employer can click 'Applications (1)' button to toggle and view applications for the job.

After successful submission, application appears exactly once in employer dashboard under QA Test Engineer job showing applicant name 'John Doe', email 'john.doe@example.com', and message 'I am interested in this position.'
Application displays correctly in employer dashboard with applicant name 'John Doe', email 'john.doe@example.com', and message 'I am interested in this position.' as a distinct record.
Employer dashboard displays accurate counts: 6 active jobs (including QA Test Engineer) and 4 total applications. Job list shows all active jobs with individual application counts for each job.
Job seeker can filter listings by industry. Filtering by 'Technology' reduced results from 9 to 3 jobs. Clearing filters restores full list of 9 jobs. Count updates immediately with filter changes.
Keyword search for 'QA' matches job title 'QA Test Engineer' and immediately filtered results from 9 to 1 job without case sensitivity. Search works by job title.

Employer can delete a job after confirming action in a confirmation dialog. Deleted QA Test Engineer job (with 1 application) is removed from employer dashboard (count: 6→5 jobs, 4→3 applications) and job-seeker listing (count: 9→8 jobs).

Filtering by location 'Remote' immediately updated visible results from 8 to 2 jobs (Product Designer and Part-Time Content Writer). No-results state would appear if no matches found. Clearing filters immediately restores full list.

After page reload, job deletions persist (QA Test Engineer job still deleted, count: 5 jobs, 3 applications). Submitted applications persist (Senior Frontend Developer: 2 applications, Product Designer: 1 application).

Job form validation prevents submission when required fields are missing (empty form didn't submit) and when salary is invalid (max '50000' < min '100000' prevented submission). Form requires: title, industry, employment type, location, description, salary range (min ≤ max), and at least one skill.

issue: Duplicate applications with same email address were not prevented
actual: System accepted 2 applications from duplicate@test.com for Senior Frontend Developer job instead of preventing the second submission. Both applications appear in employer dashboard as separate records.

issue: Job edit functionality not found or not implemented
actual: No edit button appears on employer dashboard. Job titles are not clickable for editing. Navigating to potential edit URLs (/employer/edit-job/job-1, /employer/jobs/job-1/edit) returns 404 or empty form. Post job page with ?id parameter does not pre-populate job data.

Application details in employer dashboard show applicant name, email, and message, but no submission date is displayed. Jobs display posting dates (e.g., 'Posted Yesterday', 'Posted Jan 15'), but applications do not display submission dates.
